title: Tremble at the Presence of the Lord

questions.question: When Israel went out from Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of strange what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 114:1 (ESV): "When Israel went out from Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of strange language,"

questions.question: Judah became his sanctuary, Israel his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 114:2 (ESV): "Judah became his sanctuary, Israel his dominion."

questions.question: The sea looked and did what?
Jordan turned back. The mountains skipped like what?
What ails you, O sea, that you flee? O Jordan, that you turn what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 114:5 (ESV): "...O Jordan, that you turn back?"

questions.question: O mountains, that you skip like rams? O hills, like what?
Tremble, O earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 114:7 (ESV): "...at the presence of the God of Jacob,"

questions.question: Who turns the rock into a pool of water, the flint into a spring of what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 114:8 (ESV): "...the flint into a spring of water."

questions.question: This Psalm recounts events from which book of the Bible?
questions.explanation: The crossing of the Red Sea and Jordan, and water from the rock.

questions.question: What did the Jordan river do?
What did the earth do at the presence of the Lord?
questions.explanation: Psalm 114:7 (ESV): "Tremble, O earth, at the presence of the Lord,"

questions.question: Who turned the rock into a pool of water?
What is the "strange language" referring to in verse 1?

key_verse_text: Tremble, O earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob,
